_comment: The course page ships as one HTML file with no module system, so every source file
shares one scope and load order is a real contract. This file is the only place that
order lives — it used to be the numeric prefix on every filename, which made the name
carry two jobs and left `07d-audio.js` beside `17c-learner.js` in one flat folder.
Read by coursekit/render/bundler.py. A listed file that is not on disk fails the build;
a file on disk that nobody listed fails the test suite. Either one would otherwise be
a page silently missing a feature.
Within a group the order is free — files declare functions and are order-independent.
Two rules are not free: core/state.js defines STATE before core/theme.js reads it on
load, and boot.js runs the app and stays last.
